document.title: The Local AIAL – Hydraulic Services Fit-Out (after-hours underslung waste, core drilling, soffit access)
document.scope_plain: Supply, install, test and commission sanitary drainage and hot/cold water services for the SSP "The Local" fit-out in the live terminal. Includes scanning and core drilling of the slab, HDPE waste fixed to the breezeway soffit after hours (access to height), an electrofusion tie-in to the existing DN 110 HDPE drain, and copper water from the existing ceiling-space supply. Electrical, passive fire and traffic management are by others. No excavation or confined space entry.
document.site_type: Live international terminal fit-out (occupied); underslung waste in the breezeway, after hours
document.drawings_basis: Endeavour Consulting H-000 to H-720 Rev 2 (design intent only)

document.occupancy_note: Terminal stays live. Tenancy work inside FSL hoarding; breezeway soffit work and the tie-in are after hours only, inside FSL's traffic management set-up, with a barricaded exclusion zone under every overhead point.
